letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or the gentle breezes of Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. On this bright February day, I find myself smiling at the thought of our laughter echoing through our homes, your smile lighting up every corner. You’re my endless adventure, my sweet cutie, and the love that makes every moment feel like a warm hug. Thank you for being my forever companion, my heart’s favorite melody.
poem:
In desert dunes or city streets we roam,  
Your love, my compass, always feels like home.  
Through monsoon mist or winter’s gentle kiss,  
Together, forever—our endless bliss.
